item.title: MAGA Cultists Gush That Trump Is The "Most Consequential President In History'
item.description: Asked to name their favorite president, MAGA cultists Lance Wallnau, Mark Meckler, and Rick Green all gush over Trump: "I believe Donald J. Trump will go down in history as being the most impacting transformational personality to ever enter into electoral politics."

item.title: A Godly Sense Of Terror: Theocratic Fascist Joel Webbon Backs James Fishback
item.description: Theocratic Christian fascist pastor Joel Webbon gushes that an electoral win by groyper gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will strike godly terror into the hearts of the nation's traitors.

item.title: Nick Fuentes Tells His Followers Not To Vote In 2026 'So We Get A Nazi To Run In 2028'
item.description: Nick Fuentes tells his followers not to vote in the midterms so the GOP gets wiped out, Trump gets impeached and indicted, and then "we get a Nazi to run in 2028": "I hope we get a fucking fascist to run in '28 to burn the GOP down as a dark horse and win the presidency as a right-wing radical."
